explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain exactly why the objective increases from 4700.0 to 4800.0 even though all `x[i,j]` shipment decisions remain identical to the original solution. Your answer must trace the new 100.0 gain through the code term(s) added to the objective, identify the exact CSV/general-parameter fields and values that produce it, and connect them to the business terms “safety inventory,” “terminal inventory value,” and “over-purchase penalty.” Then use the revised `solution.json` to state which of `MinSafetyInventory`, `PurchaseCap_Autumn`, and `OverStockDef` are binding/slack, interpret their dual/slack/reduced-cost information for `end_inventory_10k_m3` and `over_stock_10k_m3`, and explain why the shadow price on the safety requirement cannot be linearly extrapolated if the safety target were raised far above 20.
